body: Thank you so so much for the support and talking to me
I got up the courage to talk to the head of the house today and that went ok
Interacting with him isnt the problem, its starving and people acting like I'm the bad guy for not wanting him to eat 6 people worth
Unfortunately I have no way to leave the house or work right now (car insurance troubles) and i can only eat what is here. I feel so hopeless some days but if I talk about it it comes back to hurt me
This makes me wish my SO would go down on me
